content.short: Circular Protocol is a Layer 1 blockchain stack that can manage multiple blockchains and offers organizations a dedicated, sustainable blockchain with non-competitive mining.
content.description: Circular Protocol is a Layer 1 blockchain stack capable of managing multiple blockchains. Organizations can subscribe to a dedicated blockchain without sacrificing decentralization or security, thanks to hashing that preserves strong security costs. Circular Protocol is sustainable and employs a consensus algorithm based on non-competitive mining to support the mining industry, rather than sacrificing it as some blockchains that use proof of stake do.
content.meta: Circular Protocol provides a 4th generation Layer 1 blockchain. Discover Circular Protocol and other Blockchains on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
